cidrs.description: Address ranges (IPv4 and/or IPv6) of the VPC. May overlap with other VPCs: isolation is by overlay, not address space.

mtu.description: MTU advertised to workloads in this VPC. 0 selects the platform default.

vpcName.description: Name of the remote VPC (without "virtualprivatecloud-" prefix)

enabled.description: Open a path to the outside. Without a gateway the VPC is a closed island: no way out, no way in.

ingressLoadBalancer.description: Admit Service type=LoadBalancer traffic onto this VPC's workloads.

loadBalancerClass.description: The LoadBalancer implementation that allocates the egress identity. Empty selects the cluster default.

nat.description: Many-to-one egress for workloads with no external address of their own.
